description: Ministry of Sports - Order made to amend the Order Published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1793/3 of 15.01.2013 by adding the new Sport - '59. Roll Ball' to the end of Schedule II
reasoning: This gazette content contains an order made by the Minister of Sports under Section 28 of the Sports Act, No. 25 of 1973, which adds a new sport (Roll Ball) to Schedule II of a previous order. This constitutes a regulatory amendment and falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structural changes.
